## TRA Timeline

#### Envigo deal contemplation and form-of TRA

- 2017-08-22: 8-K announces AHPAC-Envigo Transaction Agreement; TRA contemplated as Exhibit B to the agreement
- 2018-01-12: S-4/A first attaches the form-of Tax Receivable Agreement as Exhibit 4.1

#### Envigo deal lapses, no TRA executed

- 2018-08-17: 8-K announces pivot to Organogenesis Inc. (no TRA in the new deal)
- 2018-10-30: Insider Letter Agreement amendment acknowledges failure to close by October 14, 2018 SPAC outside date; Envigo deal abandoned
- 2019-03-13: Closing 8-K for the Organogenesis business combination; conventional reverse-merger share exchange with no TRA

## Explanation

Avista Healthcare Public Acquisition Corp. (a Cayman Islands SPAC, CIK 0001661181) announced a business combination with Envigo International Holdings on August 22, 2017 that contemplated a Tax Receivable Agreement as part of the consideration mix paid to Envigo's pre-merger holders, alongside cash, AHPAC stock, and warrants. The form-of TRA was first attached as Exhibit 4.1 to the S-4/A filed January 12, 2018, naming AHPAC as Corporate Taxpayer, Envigo Holdings as a contracting party, and Jermyn Street Associates LLC as the Shareholders' Representative; the preamble date and signature blocks were left blank. The Envigo deal failed to close before the SPAC's 24-month outside date of October 14, 2018, after which AHPAC pivoted to a different target, Organogenesis Inc., which was acquired through a conventional reverse-merger share exchange on March 13, 2019 with no TRA. No post-merger Organogenesis Holdings filing references any TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
